prompts.p1:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production master illustration for a layered 2.5D game fox puppet. Use the supplied existing fox and ink game art as style references, not as an edit target.
Create ONE white juvenile fox, genuinely transparent background. Full body, exactly ONE fluffy tail, exactly FOUR anatomically plausible short legs and small fox paws, all four paws visible and separated. Compact standing cub stance, large upright ears, soft round head and short muzzle, cute young fox rather than cat, large expressive dark eyes. The BODY is a gentle three-quarter view facing slightly toward image left, but the HEAD looks STRAIGHT TOWARD CAMERA and is completely level: nose and mouth on a vertical facial center line, both eye centers at EXACTLY the same image Y coordinate, equal pupil size and a single coherent gaze at the viewer. No tilting head, no slanted skull, no one eye higher, no long side gaze.
Art direction: sparse hand inked dark charcoal purple outlines, simple large off-white shapes, a few flat gray-green shadow planes, the dark storybook 2.5D cutout game style in the reference. Smooth intentional line art, no realistic fur or painterly detail. Slightly angular fox cheek tufts and ear silhouettes. No floor, no backdrop, no shadow beneath character, no particles, no effects, no typography, no watermark. Restrained palette: warm moon white #f1eee8, pale crab-shell green #bbcdc5 shadows, dark #392f41 contours, subtle #75664d paws, no extra saturated hues. Place fox fully within canvas with ample empty alpha padding. The head must be especially readable and symmetrical at small game scale.
The single tail curves upward on image RIGHT clearly outside the body silhouette. Keep all body joints uncomplicated and visible for subsequent Spine segmentation. This is a clean assembled MASTER, not an exploded diagram or sheet.
prompts.adult:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production master for a layered 2.5D white adult fox puppet in the SAME GAME as reference image 1 (new cub) and image 2 (existing fox gallery).
Create ONE elegant adult WHITE FOX, full body, exactly FOUR long graceful fox legs and four separate paws visible, ONE individual fluffy tail raised on image RIGHT outside the body silhouette. No human anatomy, clothing, jewelry, ornaments, magic or backdrop. Thin longer torso and neck, adult proportions clearly more mature than the cub, smaller narrower head relative to body, tall angular ears, fox cheek tufts, exquisitely beautiful but dangerous. The stance is gentle three-quarter facing image LEFT, but the HEAD is perfectly FRONTAL and LEVEL, looking straight at the viewer. Nose and mouth exactly on the vertical face center. Both eye centers on EXACTLY the same horizontal image line; identical vertical placement, coherent narrow almond eyes, same pupil size and single gaze, slightly raised outer corners. Pale crab-shell green irises #bbcdc5, black vertical slit pupils, fine dark red #c32136 upper eyeliner integrated naturally into the eyelids. The red liner is narrow, no red face markings. Eyes must follow the actual skull geometry and feel symmetrical, not pasted on or rotated.
Use the same restrained spare ink-cutout style as the cub reference: confident thick charcoal-purple #392f41 contours, large warm-white #f1eee8 masses, few flat gray-green #bbcdc5 shadows. Plain sparse fur, no realistic hair, no painterly texture, no photorealism, no glossy 3D. Clean cartoon paws and leg joints ready for later Spine segmentation. The silhouette should remain legible when small. Neutral even lighting, no baked glow or colored lighting. Genuine transparent background, ample alpha padding, no floor or cast shadow. Exactly one assembled full fox master, not a sheet, not multiple views. Keep the eye alignment especially precise.
